ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to address the issue. It would examine the impact of the fraud on families and the state's budget.
questions: What is the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How are lawmakers addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant problem in Minnesota and highlight the need for greater accountability and oversight in the child care system.
